summary: SKYX Platforms filed an 8-K on Sept 10, 2026, disclosing a Sept 9 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Deako, Inc., a Seattle AI smart-home lighting company, via merger subsidiary Lumineer Merger Sub. Consideration is 25,000,000 shares, 18.46% of SKYX's outstanding stock, plus $4,000,000 cash and $8,500,000 senior secured 12% notes due 120 days and 12 months post-close. Merger shares carry a 12-month lock-up with 25% releases at months 12, 15, 18 and 21, escrowed for Deako's senior lenders, who will sell under a Rule 10b5-1 plan. Watch share overhang, note collateral, and closing conditions.
